A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''mercenary''' was a non-[[The Force/Legends|Force]] sensitive member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. She fled from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] after the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] camp. While scavenging treasures and supplies, she and a group of other mercenaries were attacked by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

The female and a [[Unidentified male mercenary (Ruusan)|male mercenary]] were the only survivors of the attack; five other mercenaries having been [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]] by Bane. The two were later taken prisoner by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who did not believe their words regarding the survival of the Sith, taking into account the two's reputation as liars.
